summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Order Assignment iOS date picker fix and preview-count enhancements. All 11 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - date inputs with onInput/onBlur fallbacks working, preview count showing both order count and label match count, employee orders page displaying pull list with matched labels.
critical_code_review_comments: Date inputs correctly use onChange + onInput + onBlur handlers for iOS compatibility
Preview count endpoint returns both count and match_count when label_ids provided
Preview display shows '83 orders found for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-11 · 5 label matches'
Zero orders scenario shows red warning: '0 orders found for this date range — check your dates'
Assign button correctly disabled when previewCount === 0
All 5 shipping labels displayed with display names (HENRY, Sara Gregg, Sacia Matheson, Rebecca Brown, Joel hieserich)
All 5 labels have SKU tags (C1083, E361, A2405, D1835, D1800)
Employee chips replace native select dropdown for iOS compatibility
Employee Orders page shows 83 items, 5 labels, 5 matched stats
Pull list items sorted by SKU and show matched labels inline
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test assignment for employee orders page testing, cleaned up after test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order assignment iOS date picker fix verified. Key data-testids: assign-orders-btn, assign-employee-select, assign-since-date, assign-until-date, preview-item-count, confirm-assign-btn, orders-page, pull-item-{id}, preview-matched-{id}, print-all-labels-btn, complete-orders-btn. Preview count endpoint at GET /api/orders/preview-count accepts since, until, label_ids params and returns {count, match_count}. Assignment endpoint at POST /api/orders/assign creates assignment with item_count, label_count, match_count.
